app[content][earlyaccess][why]: Early Access gives us a chance to build a community and receive feedback the game needs to reach its best version. Seeing what players love and hate will help us shape the final release.
app[content][earlyaccess][how_long]:
I'm planning for the Early Access stage to take no longer than 6 months. Regular updates till we create a complete experience that isn't trying to be everything at once.
I aim to create a polished neat little product that shines and goes down smooth.
That said if there's interest for it post full release I'd love to push some updates.
app[content][earlyaccess][full_version]:
Planned updates in mind including extra content like extra items, characters, endings and new environments to play in, as well as polish and balance of course.
But mostly we're excited about seeing what the community enjoys about the game and expanding from there.
app[content][earlyaccess][current_state]:
The game is in a fully playable state with an established core loop that won't change in the future. We have already implemented over 100 trinkets, spells and snacks, multiple playable characters, special dice effects and meta progression.
See About This Game for more info!

The game might have bugs that we haven't found, it's missing some characters, trinkets, challenge runs and other features that will modify and expand the game.
app[content][earlyaccess][pricing]: Yes. But I want to keep it on cheaper side, it'll most likely get a raise by a few bucks.
app[content][earlyaccess][community]:
I'm curious to see how a wider audience interacts with the game. I wanna know how they feel about it. Looking forward to seeing players opinions on strong and weak sides of the game.

Having a Discord community with a place to share different builds, discuss updates and current meta will be fun. We don't have a hired community manager so players will have to put up with speaking directly to me, Franek, and with the coder, Max.
